title: intent bootstrap --check reports OK for an install whose gate cannot run
body:
Found by dc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit, on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: `intent bootstrap --check` says `state: OK` (rc 0) when the pointer names an install whose `lib/templates/` lacks `hooks/pre-commit.sh`, while the shim refuses every commit with its FAILURE 3, naming the missing file. `can_run` is `Resolves` (`install.rs:606-610`), deliberately mirroring the shim's `--where`.

Expected: `--check` answers whether the gate can run, not only whether it resolves.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- filed for after the stabilisation line: it needs a broken install and the commit refusal names the cause. `docs/install.md` says what `--check` checks, as built.


Fixed in 3.2.2 by `2c698bb1d` (vc, 2026-09-25): the commit message names the bank, its patch-id and the judge.
